questions.q: True or false? With the defender standing in the middle, the pass straight ahead is the clear route.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The defender sits in the central lane, so we play around them to the left.
choiceExplanations: The defender stands in that central lane, so a pass straight ahead can be cut out.

questions.q: Put the play around the pressure in order, from first to last.
options: Spot the clear lane outside them
Pass around to the wide teammate
questions.explain: Yes. Look first, find the open lane, pass around, and your teammate can face forward.
